title: The warning appears and disappears as the grid is edited
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, with one range from $0.00: Default on Margin % 40, tier A on % Off 5.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Replace tier A's value with 95.
  5. Replace tier A's value with 5.
  6. Replace tier A's value with 95.
  7. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's value reads 5% off.
  • Tier A's 5% off value has no warning icon.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit with tier A's value 5 in its box.
  • Tier A's value 5 has no warning icon.

Step 4:

  • The warning icon appears beside tier A's value 95 before anything is saved.

Step 5:

  • The warning icon is gone from tier A's value 5.
  • The value 5 still shows in tier A's cell.

Step 6:

  • The warning icon shows beside 95 again.

Step 7:

  • The grid saves and returns to view with tier A on 95% off.
  • The warning icon still shows beside tier A's 95% off in view.
